pullRequests.title: Checkout: prevent shipping coupon from applying twice
summary: Fixes a bug where a shipping coupon adjustment could be created twice during checkout recalculation.
Updates payment intent calculation to use the final computed total after discounts.
Adds a regression test covering the double-application scenario.
risks: Checkout total calculation behavior changed; edge cases may exist for mixed discounts.
Payment intent amount now strictly follows computed totals; verify with payment provider sandbox.
